card.name: The word of after loss
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "loss" in warnings about drug interactions, as in "loss of virologic response" or "loss of therapeutic effect". It also fires weakly on a few linking words in the early-treatment phrases.

modes.label: Loss of effect
modes.description: "of" after "loss" in interaction warnings, before a term for lost response or control.
modes.example: Co-administration with efavirenz is not recommended because it may result in loss<< of>> therapeutic effect and development of resistance to dar

modes.label: Early treatment phase
modes.description: A linking word in phrases about the start of therapy or about dose changes.
modes.example: During the initial phase<< of>> combination antiretroviral treatment,

card.writes: It seems to push toward the words that come after "loss of", but the promoted tokens are mixed and not clearly related.
card.plain: It marks the word "of" in "loss of" when a label warns that a drug may stop working.
